slices.focus: Duplicate object numbers discovered during audit force a wider overhaul including numbering reconciliation and image attachment checks
slices.summary: A conservation intern discovers duplicate object numbers in the works-on-paper cabinets, revealing years of inconsistent data entry. Hannah widens the overhaul to include numbering reconciliation and image attachment verification, imposing a temporary freeze on nonessential moves.
open_loops: Write restart threshold with three visible checks: confirmed numbering, image attachment, shelf label
Circulate example packet (screenshots showing how mismatch traveled) with short note together
Prioritize cabinets and ranges most likely to have old numbering drift
Protect intern by framing discovery as systems alert, not personal fault-finding
decisions: Hannah remains registrar and widened the collections overhaul to include numbering reconciliation and image attachment c
